mentions.name: Community-Funded 3D Model Design Request Platform
mentions.description: This web platform lets users post 3D model design requests together with a pledge, and the community can add pledges to attract designers. It enables people who need models missing from online 3D libraries like Thingiverse and TurboSquid to commission designs from 3D artists, designers, and engineers with community funding, while designers own the IP and get paid for enriching public 3D model libraries.
mentions.problem: Online 3D model libraries like Thingiverse and TurboSquid are missing models that people want, and enthusiasts who need them often lack the design skills to create them.
mentions.audience: 3D printing enthusiasts who don't know how to design, visual effect (VFX) professionals requesting designs, and 3D artists, designers, and engineers who fulfill paid requests
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a web platform where:
You post a 3D model design request while making a pledge (like submitting a ticket) and the community can make additional pledges to attract designers to make things missing from online 3D model libraries like thingiverse and turbosquid.
Essentially, we're allowing 3D printing enthusiasts who don't know how to design, visual effect (VFX) professionals to request designs from 3D artists, designers, engineers with community funding essentially.
Designers own the IP and are encouraged to enrich the public 3D model libraries while getting paid.
